_doc: Serious/critical axe violations that existed when the golden-path a11y gate was introduced (2026-10-24), recorded on dev after a full golden run. May only SHRINK: fix a violation and delete its entry (an entry that no longer occurs FAILS the run), or lower its max. Never add an entry or raise a max to make a red run green. Keyed by page path (ids -> :id); selector = nearest anchor + the tags/names down to the node (tests/e2e/golden-paths/helpers/a11yDescribe.ts); max = most nodes allowed to match; dataDriven = how many nodes match (even none) follows the company's data or async state, so any number is allowed and the entry is never stale (reason given per entry). scripts/verify-deploy.sh runs report-only (A11Y_GATE=report). 'shell:*' keys are pieces of the app shell scanned on their own.
